$comment: THE GATE REGISTRY. This file, not a reading of HONESTY_LOG.md, decides E5.
Why it exists (ADR-028): E5 says 'zero open wrong-score entries'. Until this
file, nothing carried a classification, so evaluating E5 meant a fresh session
re-reading 74 prose entries and forming an opinion. Different session, different
opinion — E5 flipped MET/NOT MET three times without the code changing once.
HONESTY_LOG.md remains the append-only narrative and is still where the
reasoning lives. This file is the index the gate is computed from.
severity: wrong-score | false-refusal | coverage-gap | integrity | process | unclassified
wrong-score   the tool reports a number that is wrong, or fabricates evidence. BLOCKS.
false-refusal declines something it could have read. Visible to the recruiter. Does not block.
coverage-gap  an input not yet understood. Product scope. Does not block.
integrity     cannot produce a wrong score, but corrupts or bypasses stored state.
process       about how the work is done, not about product behaviour.
unclassified  NEVER TRIAGED. Blocks E5 by design — see ADR-028 Decision 1.
Adding an entry to HONESTY_LOG.md without adding it here fails `pnpm gate`.
That completeness check is the point: H-004 and H-044 are both cases of a
registry quietly covering less than it appeared to.

findings.note: TRIAGED 2026-08-13, NOT wrong-score today, and this is the one call that LOOSENS the gate. H-002's stated mechanism is ONNX Runtime float kernels — measured: there is no ORT, no embedding model, and no transcendental or approximated float operation anywhere in packages/core. Only IEEE-754 + - * / (correctly rounded on every conforming platform) and exact Math.max/min/abs/round/floor. So no mechanism exists by which two conforming machines can differ. PINNED by determinism.arch.test.ts, which fails if a transcendental, an exponentiation operator or an inference runtime enters core — that failure is the signal to RE-TRIAGE, not to relax the test. Becomes live wrong-score risk the moment cascade step 4 (embeddings) lands.
Section 7 LLM validator catches fabricated entities, not fabricated relations. Not built; no scoring path depends on it.
Matrix half CLOSED (H-046, 0.34s). OCR and embeddings budgets still unmeasured.
--no-verify bypasses hooks. Unfixable client-side; CI is the backstop.
British degree abbreviations silently ignored. Fixed and pinned by R10.
Umbrella entry for D1-D8. D1-D6 fixed; D7 tracked separately below; D8 triaged in H-066.
Seniority thresholds unpinned. Closed by generated properties.
Lower-case 'as' yielded an associate degree. Fixed, pinned by R10.
Invisible characters FABRICATED skills. Fixed, pinned by R11/R12.
369 mutation survivors (was 607). explain.ts largest block at 74.76%. E4 passes regardless.

CLOSED by ADR-029/H-081. When a discarded explicit tenure claim would flip the eligibility verdict, scoreCandidate reports a blocking Reservation and scoreStoredPair refuses to persist a match. Materiality is computed by re-running the experience gate with the discarded claim, not guessed. Residual, stated: a non-blocking reservation can still move the score and rank order.

CLOSED by ADR-034, and NOT by language detection - that route was measured to destruction first (H-112). The wrong score was never really 'we failed to detect a foreign line'; it was 'we asserted a NEGATIVE from silence'. A foreign degree line yields no education attribute, so the engine reported 'Requires at least a bachelor degree' about a graduate, flipping the same person between 100/eligible and 50/ineligible on the language their degree was written in. apps/server now emits an unreadable_section attribute for a line it cannot read INSIDE a recognised section whose dimension has NO other evidence, and scoreCandidate raises a blocking unsupported_negative reservation when a must-have is unmet in that dimension - so the engine refuses rather than asserting. Two gates make a 2-word floor safe where 6 was needed before: the section gate excludes the header block where NAMES live (the thing that made every previous attempt a discrimination risk), and the zero-evidence gate excludes technology lists. Measured 0/50 English documents affected across all 23 English CVs and the whole fixture corpus, while a foreign Education line is caught in German, Dutch, Turkish, Hungarian, Greek, Vietnamese, Russian, Japanese and Arabic. RESIDUAL as H-113.
A hand-edited test manifest still passes. Floor guard blocks the accident, not the intent.
An unreadable JOB scored candidates 100/100. C7 now enforced on both sides.
Closed by ADR-024 — derived attributes are never persisted.
'<degree> of <field>' is genuinely ambiguous. Product scope.
Asserted E5 on an unchecked assumption. Superseded by H-063 and ADR-027.
roundHalfUp error bound breaks above ~1e9, outside the scoring domain. Do NOT reuse the function elsewhere.
Branch coverage not reproducible run to run; no fast-check seed pinned. Deliberate — pinning would cost the property that found the Remi Dubois defect.

CLOSED. Re-triaged to wrong-score when an ADR-015 round produced the PDF fixture losing a section that this entry asked to be re-examined for (H-100). Its stated MECHANISM was falsified in the same round - no pdfjs hasEOL error is involved, hasEOL was correct in every arm - and the actual defect, detectSections' whole-line header rule, is fixed. The original 'no vertical-gap fallback in the PDF line model' concern is NOT what this was, and no evidence of a line-model defect was found.
Closed by H-066 (D8 triaged) and ADR-027 (H-041 classified).
PDF generator cannot render non-WinAnsi text, so invisible-character fixtures are DOCX-only. Test-infrastructure gap, not product behaviour.
Measurement folded into H-041, which is the tracked entry. Its 'property of CVs' framing was an overstatement — corrected in ADR-027.
The record of the ADR-027 decision. The defect itself is tracked as H-041.
R-L1 cannot generate the defect it names. This is what E2 fails on — tracked by E2, not E5.
Handoff docs disagreed on a gate result. Structurally prevented from recurring by this registry.
CLOSED by ADR-029: the fixture now asserts the refusal, the refusal reason, and that the veto fired because a passage was JUDGED rather than because the whole-document classifier flipped.
Branch-coverage total carried forward across three phases. Quote n/total, never the percentage alone.
audit_log INSERT OR REPLACE bypass. Cannot produce a wrong score; corrupts the audit trail. Not tracked in HONESTY_LOG as its own heading — it is an H-028 sub-item.
The gate reform itself (ADR-028). Recorded, not open work.

quantize/roundHalfUp used `10 ** decimals`, ECMAScript's only implementation-approximated operation in the whole scoring path — inside the very function ADR-009 added to mitigate H-002. Replaced with a 16-entry table of exact literals, verified equal to 10**n across the accepted [0,15] domain. Found by the arch test written to pin H-002.

The blank-line-delimited variant of the H-041 fix measured 0 false refusals but FAILED on the PDF path at every proportion below ~49%, because PDF loses blank lines. Killed by measurement. My first PDF check passed only because I tested at a favourable single point.

The H-041 fix is a narrowing (4/10 -> 1/10 unjudged), not a closure. I measured it before the prose gate landed and briefly recorded it as fixing all four; a test I had just written caught the overstatement.
The prose gate added in ADR-029 is English/Romance-biased; German noun capitalisation defeats it and a German-English bilingual header CV is scored. H-022's shape.

Refusing on zero language evidence closes the German residual but costs 3/18 English CVs and violates the eval's standing requirement that headers_plus_tech_only passes. I quoted 10% to the user from the held-out set alone before checking the in-corpus set.
The H-040 remedy, and four defects lint/types caught in my own change.

The 15-WORD segment floor was biased against compounding languages (DE/NL/SV pack ~1.7x more letters per word), so they were never judged. The prose gate blamed in H-079 was a symptom; the floor's UNIT was the defect.

For German compound-noun blocks the n-gram classifier returns the WRONG verdict (English, nearest=Italian), not merely a silent one. Profiles are built from prose and a compound list is out-of-domain. A gate cannot repair a wrong verdict.

The relative-margin threshold H-041 rejected for whole documents DOES separate at segment level (worst English +0.0180 vs weakest genuine foreign +0.0399). Re-measuring a finding in a different scope was cheap and productive.
After ADR-030, a foreign insert below the ~100-letter window floor is still scored. Found by an adversarial round run specifically because H-078 records calling a narrowing a closure.

ADR-030 falsely refused 2 of 5 Indian-English CVs - the target recruiter's primary case. Long transliterated proper nouns look like compound morphology (9.43 and 9.54 vs a 9.4 threshold). H-022's shape a third time: neither English corpus contained an Indian CV. Fixed with an English-institution-word exemption; Indian CVs added as a permanent third corpus.

Romance sub-floor inserts closed by a two-distinct-function-word line signal (0 false positives in 70 English lines). Germanic sub-floor inserts remain open - compound lines have no function words and mean word length does not separate at line level.

Indian degrees B.E./M.E./MCA/BCA/PGDM extracted NOTHING, scoring real candidates 50 and INELIGIBLE with 'Requires at least a bachelor degree'. Patterns added and false-positive guards verified for the ordinary words 'be'/'me'. RESIDUAL: a bare BE/M.E. with a field outside FIELD_VOCAB's 14 US-skewed entries is still missed - 'Electronics and Communication', 'Structural Engineering'. Fix is the vocabulary, not the patterns. Classified coverage-gap per ADR-023's own example (degree-vocabulary gaps), but it FLIPS ELIGIBILITY, so re-triage if that example is ever revisited.

CLOSED for its named mechanism: a THREE-PART ambiguous numeric date no longer deletes a role or guesses a locale. ADR-032 consumes the whole token and emits an unreadable_date_range attribute plus an unreadable_employment_dates reservation, with materiality bounded by the smaller of the two locale readings. Pinned - 4 tests fail without the fix. SCOPE OF THE CLOSURE, stated: three-part forms only. The ADR-015 round confirmed every three-part separator behaves, and found five FURTHER silent tenure defects that ADR-032 does not touch (H-100 to H-104) plus the still-live two-part half of H-095.

The B.4 date fix changed live behaviour with experience.test.ts untouched - no test failed without it, so by ADR-028 it was not closed. Caught by reading git status, not the report. Fixed in the same commit: 5 targeted tests, verified 3 fail on revert, 67/67 pass with the fix. Trap 2 from NEXT_PHASE section 5, one session after being written down.

Language-ID survey falsified the brief's premise: franc catches only 10/13 Germanic sub-floor lines, consistent with it being the same trigram method as the existing Cavnar & Trenkle code. eld@2.1.0 measured best (13/13, 9/96). Licence, C4 determinism (zero real Math.* calls) and C2 offline verified independently by the lead. cld3-asm rejected: emscripten-wasm-loader@3.0.3 has NO LICENSE file anywhere, which license-audit.mjs would have silently passed. NO ADR WRITTEN, eld NOT INSTALLED - open until the user decides.

eld Phase-1: 64 configurations swept, NO configuration meets the bar. Window granularity = 0/23 false refusals but 0-1/13 Germanic; line granularity + reliable = 13/13 Germanic but 2/23 false refusals. The gap is GEOMETRY, not library accuracy - a trailing sub-floor line never forms a window. Valuable side result: eld at window granularity subsumes the whole Cavnar & Trenkle apparatus plus MAX_ENGLISH_MEAN_WORD_LENGTH, ENGLISH_INSTITUTION_WORDS and MIN_FOREIGN_MARGIN at zero measured regression. Decision belongs to the user.

Test manifest regenerated (913 identities) and minTests raised 844 -> 913 after the H-088 documented-gap test was deliberately flipped by Task B.1. Reason recorded as the integrity check demands. Notable: this check and pnpm typecheck each caught something a subagent's own scoped green run did not.

The ADR-015 verifier agreed with the lead's wrong-score verdict on H-089 and falsified the lead's DESCRIPTION on four counts. Agreement on the label concealed disagreement on the facts. Most serious: the code docstring claimed the ambiguous case was 'deliberately left unresolved rather than silently guessing a locale', which is false - measured and reproduced independently by the lead. Docstring and the DOCUMENTED GAP test corrected in the same commit.

CLOSED. The three-part half was fixed by ADR-032; this entry's own named mechanism - the slash-only \d{1,2}/\d{4} two-part alternative - is now fixed too. TWO_PART_DATE_TOKEN accepts . and - separators and both MM[sep]YYYY and YYYY[sep]MM orders. Verified: 03.2019 - Present now 7.4 (was 7.6 with the span truncated to '2019 - Present'), 2015-03 - Present now 11.4 (was a deleted role). No ambiguity machinery needed - a 4-digit group is unambiguously the year wherever it sits. H-040's original 03.2006 notation therefore parses at last.

Manifest shrink 916 -> 915 was a deliberate rename (one DOCUMENTED GAP test replaced by three that pin actual behaviour, H-094), requiring --allow-shrink because the tool cannot distinguish a rename from a deletion. Separately: the lead set minTests to 917 by arithmetic rather than measurement; the real count is 915 and the tool refused the guess. Trap 3 committed by the lead in the same session they removed a stale E4 figure from the handoff for the same reason.

Six manifest identities removed, all deliberate renames: three in languageDetection.eval.test.ts (two H-086 tests whose TITLES asserted the now-deleted institution exemption as load-bearing - a passing test teaching a false mechanism; one KNOWN LIMITATION flipped because eld reads a comma-separated tech list as English, narrowly and in the safer direction) and three DOCUMENTED GAP tests in experience.test.ts flipped to FIXED. Manifest 952, floor 915 -> 952 taken from the tool's output rather than arithmetic (cf H-096). Also records that the extraction engineer correctly refused to fabricate a fourth DOCUMENTED GAP test the lead's brief wrongly claimed existed.

The only defect in a three-engineer parallel round came from the SEAM between two scopes, not from either scope. refuse-mixed-language changed refusal REASON (non_english_language_not_supported -> mixed_language_content) after the eld swap; the refusal itself was intact and the new reason is more truthful for a 50/50 bilingual document, which now exercises the ADR-022 segment veto on the binary path. Neither engineer could see it: ingestion's scope excluded fixtures/, extraction's excluded apps/server/. Conflict-free-by-directory prevents write conflicts but NOT behavioural coupling - an argument for the lead's serialized full verify.

BATCH path bypassed the ADR-029 blocking-reservation refusal. Same job, same candidate, same reference date: scoreStoredPair THREW and wrote nothing, while scoreJobAgainstCandidates scored 64 and PERSISTED the matches row - and the batch path is the entry point a 'score this job against my pool' action uses, so ADR-029's guarantee was reachable only by the path nobody calls. Made H-040's 'closed' note false as written. FIXED: the batch path now skips rather than persisting, deliberately differing from the single path's throw because a batch must not let one unreconcilable candidate deny service to the pool - `skipped` already means 'we could not read this document'. Pinned; the test fails without the guard (verified by removing it).

CLOSED for the wrong-score. detectSections now recognises a header that shares its line, via a strict separator (2+ spaces, tab, or 2+ rule characters - never a single space) plus CONSTRAINED trailing matter (date-shaped or location-shaped only). Letter-spaced headers are collapsed before matching. Verified by the lead: all 6 header forms recognised, all 6 adversarial lines rejected including 'Experience   Team Lead, Acme Corp, 2019 - 2022' (a dated job-title row), and end-to-end the education dates are no longer credited as employment. RESIDUAL registered separately as H-108.

CLOSED. Only a future START now rejects a range; a future END is CLAMPED to the reference date, exactly as 'Present' already resolves. Chosen over surfacing a reservation because the target date is known, so materiality is directly computable and ADR-029's 'unaccounted-for evidence' case does not apply. Verified: 'Jan 2015 - Dec 2026' at ref 2026-08 now 11.6 (was a deleted role), and the far-future guard still rejects 'Jan 2030 - Jan 2032'.

CLOSED. The D5c quantity-word window crossed newlines, so a metric bullet on the ADJACENT line tripped it. The window is now clamped to the same line. Verified: '2015 - 2026' followed by 'Scaled the platform to two million users.' now counts 11 years (was 0), while every same-line D5c positive still rejects - 'budget of 2000 - 2024 USD', 'Grew active users from 2015 - 2019' and all 29 parametrized quantity-word cases.

CLOSED, on the SECOND attempt. The first fix required the literal word 'experience' to follow; it killed the fabrications and also dropped 'Over 20 years in backend engineering', '15 years as a registered nurse' and 'with 18 years in the trade' - ordinary CV phrasing. The lead caught this before commit: an explicit claim is what totalYearsExperience falls back to when no range parses, so that fix relocated the wrong number from fabricated-high to silently-zero, which is H-101/H-102's own shape. Replaced with a GRAMMATICAL discriminator: English uses the singular attributively ('15 year old system', '20 year partnership') and the plural for accumulated time. Plural = claim; singular = claim only when 'experience' follows, which keeps '1 year of experience'. 'years old' excluded outright per ADR-007. Verified 5/5 fabrications rejected, 8/8 legitimate claims found.

CLOSED. Per-range roundHalfUp(months/12, 1) before summing biased every range up - a systematic +20% on 3-month ranges, compounding with range count. Ranges now carry the exact fraction and the sum is rounded ONCE. Verified: 17 consecutive 3-month contracts now report 4.3 against a truth of 4.25 (was 5.1, which wrongly cleared a 5-year must-have). SECOND HALF, caught by the lead before commit: rounding once at quantize's 6dp showed the recruiter 'found 11.583333'. Arithmetic precision and DISPLAY precision are different jobs - the per-range rounding had been incidentally supplying the 1dp presentation. Totals now round to 1dp at the sum, and normalizedValue is labelled at 1dp while `years` stays exact.

H-041's scope note was falsified by measurement. It read 'Romance sub-floor inserts CLOSED, residual is GERMANIC'; the ADR-015 round scored 5 of 7 foreign degree lines end-to-end (German, Polish, Turkish, Romanian, Indonesian) and 7 of 9 in a second arm including Czech and Portuguese. The residual is every language outside the 8-language function-word lexicon, including two ROMANCE ones. H-041's note corrected in the same commit. Matters because a remedy aimed at 'Germanic' would not have measured the languages that actually fail.

CLOSED. stripNeutralTokens is now applied before the function-word scan (it was running on the raw line), the 7 tokens that are ordinary English words were removed (van, door, die, den, est, con, par - measured cost: 0 against both closed Romance sub-floor cases), and the 5 proper-noun-prone tokens kept (el, los, la, le, de) now require lowercase in the original text, so El Paso / Los Angeles / Le Gavroche / De Pere no longer count. Raising MIN_FUNCTION_WORD_HITS to 3 was measured and REJECTED - it loses the French sub-floor catch outright - and is recorded in the code as a rejected lever. Final: 0/23 English CVs falsely refused, 0/17 adversarial English lines (was 15/17), 13/13 non-English still refused, 2/2 Romance sub-floor still caught.

CLOSED under a disclosed assumption. Ambiguous ranges no longer each contribute an independent lower bound: when 2+ exist, they are merged under ONE locale reading applied to all of them (day-first, then month-first) and the smaller grand total wins, so overlap is deduped. For exactly one ambiguous range this reduces to the previous per-range computation. SOUNDNESS, stated rather than hidden: min(dayFirst, monthFirst) <= truth holds provided the document does not MIX locales across its own ambiguous ranges, which is not structurally provable. Disclosed in the code and in dimensions.ts.

Residual of H-100's fix, found and disclosed by the engineer who wrote it and reproduced by the lead. A DATELESS line of the form '<header word>' + strict separator + Title-Case pair - e.g. 'Experience   Team Lead, Acme Corp' - is recognised as a header, because a job-title-and-employer pair is syntactically indistinguishable from a location ('Leeds, UK') once no digits are present. NO TENURE IMPACT: the dated form 'Experience   Team Lead, Acme Corp, 2019 - 2022' is correctly rejected, and dates are what drive tenure. The blast radius is a section boundary shifting on a dateless line, which can misattribute following lines between education and experience. Also unhandled: a letter-spaced header WITH trailing matter ('E D U C A T I O N   Leeds, UK').

A fix relocated a wrong number instead of removing it, and it took the lead's own verification to catch. H-103's first implementation required the literal word 'experience', which killed the fabrications AND dropped ordinary claims like '15 years as a registered nurse' - producing 'found 0' for a candidate with fifteen years, the same silent-zero shape as H-101 and H-102 being closed in the same commit. Separately H-104's first implementation removed per-range rounding correctly but left the total at quantize's 6dp, so the recruiter would have been shown 'found 11.583333'. BOTH were reported by the engineer as clean closures with passing tests. The lesson is not that the engineer erred - the tests genuinely passed - but that 'the named defect is gone' and 'the defect class is gone' are different claims, and only end-to-end probing of what a recruiter SEES distinguishes them.

E4 holds but the TREND is the finding, and four measurements now show it: 80.42 -> 80.39 -> 80.02 -> 79.85 across ADR-031, ADR-032 and ADR-034. Headroom above the 79 ratchet is down to 0.85, below this project's usual ~1 point, so the next core change may break the build. experience.ts remains the weakest module at 69.36% while being the file that computes TENURE - the number every wrong-score finding here has been about. Not a behavioural regression: every fix has a test that fails without it. The cause is that defect-targeted tests pin the defect and not the surrounding arithmetic, so each round of fixes adds more mutable code than it adds mutation coverage. Left open deliberately: raising it means writing tests against surviving mutants rather than defects, a different and larger activity. The right response to a future break is to raise the score, not to lower the ratchet.

The H-041 evidence floor was raised TWICE during its own implementation, both times because the measurement pool was missing a population, and both times caught by widening the corpus rather than by argument. At a 4-word floor the sweep looked clean at 0/96 English lines - then adding hand-written lines exposed 2 refusals, both candidate NAMES of non-Anglo origin. At 5 words it looked clean at 0/139 - then the full verify failed on the fixture corpus, exposing 2 more, both language-neutral TECHNOLOGY LISTS. Final floor 6, measured 0/258. H-022's shape twice inside one fix, by the lead, in the same session the lead recorded it as trap 1. The lesson that generalises: an English corpus assembled by hand systematically under-samples proper nouns and neutral token lists, which are precisely what a line-level language classifier fails on.

Exhaustive negative result for H-041, recorded so it is not re-derived. Measured against 258 English lines and 26 short foreign lines in 15 languages: confidence margin OVERLAPS (real Dutch +0.109 vs English name +0.115), absolute en-score OVERLAPS (real German 0.601 vs English name 0.664), a 40-point grid of margin x score x floor yields ZERO designs at 0 false refusals, larger eld ngram tiers are strictly WORSE, and capitalisation filtering is dead because German nouns are capitalised (H-079). The evidence floor is the only lever and it is disqualified twice over: what it refuses as it drops is candidate NAMES, overwhelmingly non-Anglo and four of them from INDIAN_CV_CORPUS (H-028 D3's discrimination shape), AND it plateaus at 23/26 because hu/vi/el are eld coverage limits rather than floor effects - strictly worse on both axes, so not a trade worth offering. ROOT CAUSE: a person's name IS foreign text ('Nguyen Thi Minh Anh' scores vi 0.834 with en 0.000, a stronger signal than any genuine foreign line), so no line-level classifier can separate the two. The only remaining route is the scoring question of whether a must-have may be asserted unmet purely from ABSENCE of evidence, which needs its own ADR and adversarial round.

Residual of ADR-034. A foreign line TRANSLITERATED into bare ASCII - diacritics and native alphabet stripped - is still not recognised as unreadable, so the H-041 harm survives for that input. Measured: Hungarian, Greek and Vietnamese are all CAUGHT in native orthography and all MISSED transliterated. Recorded as coverage-gap rather than wrong-score because bare-ASCII transliteration is not a CV format - it is an artefact of how the first adversarial set for this fix was written, working around the WinAnsi font constraint the fixture corpus has (H-067). Worth stating plainly: it would have been easy to record 'eld cannot do Hungarian' as the residual, and that would have been false. ALSO residual, on ADR-029's already-accepted terms: a foreign line in a dimension that HAS other evidence moves the score without flipping eligibility, and raises nothing - the same boundary H-040 was closed on.

A simpler rule was measured and REJECTED, recorded so it is not 'simplified' into later. Dropping the language signal entirely - 'Education section present, zero education/certification evidence, must-have unmet' - would close H-041's residual completely and needs no classifier at all. It costs 1/50 corpus documents (uni_lines_only), and the shape it refuses is a CV listing institutions and dates with no degree token ('University of Manchester, 2009-2013'), which is common in real CVs. That trades a rare defect for a frequent refusal. The language gate stays because it targets unreadable FOREIGN text specifically and measures 0/50.

H-041 closed after five sessions, and E5 is MET. It was named a language-detection defect and three sessions went into detecting the foreign line better - prose gate, compounding signal, function-word lexicon, mean-word-length threshold, institution exemption, a full classifier swap to eld, a 40-point threshold grid. Each narrowed it; none closed it. H-112 settled why with measurement: a person's NAME is foreign text, so no line-level classifier can separate the two, and every floor low enough to catch a short foreign degree line refuses candidates by the origin of their name. The actual defect was one sentence the engine had no right to say - 'Requires at least a bachelor degree', printed when it had extracted no education at all. ADR-034 makes it decline to assert a must-have unmet while holding unread text in that requirement's section. THE LESSON: the defect's NAME encoded a hypothesis about its cause, the hypothesis was wrong, and what closed it was asking what the recruiter was actually shown - the same shape as H-040, H-089, H-101 and H-102, all filed under different names. What closed it was not a smarter classifier but an engine more willing to say it did not know.

The first real CV ever uploaded was refused on its CONTACT line (mixed_language_content). Measured on the real file: whole-doc verdict English (correct), 1 of 58 segments flagged - line 1. Chain: stripNeutralTokens' URL pattern requires https:// so scheme-less 'linkedin.com/in/username' survives and splits into 4 junk words, lifting the line past the 6-word floor; the judged text is then a Spanish-origin US city plus the candidate's own name - H-112's 'a name is foreign text' arriving through the ADR-022 veto, which has NO header-block gate (ADR-034's exclusion covers only the unreadable_section path). Sixth instance of trap 1: the 258-line pool contained no real-shaped contact line. FIX PLAN in docs/NEXT_PHASE.md: strip dotted/scheme-less tokens as neutral, section-gate the veto's line pass, and add a real-shaped contact-line corpus before re-measuring.

Jobs cannot be deleted from the UI. DELETE /api/jobs/:id exists and is tested; no UI element calls it - jobs list and job page render no delete control, and the needs-attention job page (where deletion is most wanted) shows only the warning. PRODUCT_DECISIONS makes explicit deletion part of the privacy boundary. The ADR-036 browser verification missed it because the walkthrough only added things - a pass that never deletes cannot find a missing delete button.
